entry.name: ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer / Lead Auditor
entry.note: Credentials against the AI management system standard the compliance section tracks
entry.audience: AI management system implementers and auditors

reading.summary: ISO/IEC 42001 specifies requirements and guidance for establishing, implementing, maintaining, and continually improving an artificial intelligence management system within an organization. PECB training courses equip individuals with the competencies needed to plan, develop, implement, maintain, and improve such a system. Holding or finishing this credential shows proficiency in managing AI systems according to the standard.
reading.audience: Individuals seeking proficiency in artificial intelligence management systems.
